title: Bowls and bags display
slide_intent: Repeat a small set of materials and colors in a space so separate objects read as one environment.
strategic_value: The green tiles, bags and simple vessels can give Sweetgreen’s retail space a coherent material character.
demonstration: Wood shelves against green tiles hold pale bowls and small plants; green and kraft bags hang from hooks along the bottom.
practical_value: Compare identity expressed through objects and material repetition with identity expressed through printed graphics.

content_islands.name: Upper shelves
content_islands.spec: Arrange pale bowls and plants along the timber shelves.

content_islands.name: Hanging bags
content_islands.spec: Place green and kraft bags below the shelving against the tiled wall.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph coordinates serving vessels, bags and shelving within a retail environment.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green tile, timber, kraft paper and pale bowls form a repeated material palette.
